p: Send thou men: After the people had required it of Moses, as it is in De 1:22 then the Lord told Moses to do it.
men whom Moses sent to spy: Which in number were twelve according to the twelve tribes.
good or bad: Plentiful or barren.
Zin unto Rehob: Which was in the wilderness of Paran.
Anak: Which were a type of giant.
Hebron was built seven years before: Declaring the antiquity of it: also Abraham, Sarah, Isaac and Jacob were buried there.
children of Anak there: Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, whom Caleb slew afterward, Jos 11:21,22.
eateth up the inhabitants thereof: The giants were so cruel, that they spoiled and killed one another and those that came to them.
